title: Reservation Demand Recorded-Capacity Arithmetic
purpose: Purely align canonical FOOD-007E reservation demand and exact source-revision selection with canonical FOOD-007L recorded-capacity arithmetic and compute a signed demand-adjusted arithmetic delta.
algorithm: Strictly capture and validate the FOOD-007E selection request without invoking accessors.
Validate its reservation request and fulfillment intent through their canonical structural validators.
Require the request fulfillment-intent reference and quote reference to agree with the supplied canonical fulfillment intent.
Require each request capacity requirement, each selected SKU revision and each FOOD-007L SKU arithmetic entry to align by demand-order index, SKU id, SKU version and exact capacity revision.
Require the selected fulfillment slot and FOOD-007L slot arithmetic entry to align by method, location reference, window reference and exact capacity revision.
Recheck FOOD-007L arithmetic identity: recordedCapacityDelta must exactly equal capacityUnits minus recordedHeldQuantity.
For every SKU compute recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta = recordedCapacityDelta - demandQuantity.
For the selected fulfillment slot use the current canonical one-slot reservation quantity of 1 and compute recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta = recordedCapacityDelta - 1.
Use BigInt subtraction and reject any result outside the signed JavaScript safe-integer range.
Preserve positive, zero and negative arithmetic exactly; never clamp.
Return a deeply frozen detached result.
negativeArithmetic: Negative recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta is preserved exactly and is not clamped.
safeClaim: For each exactly aligned recorded capacity-source revision, the returned signed value is only the mathematical difference between FOOD-007L recordedCapacityDelta and the canonical reservation demand quantity associated with that same selected SKU revision; for the selected fulfillment slot the current storage contract contributes one demand unit.
authorityBoundary: recordedDemandAdjustedCapacityDelta is neutral arithmetic evidence only. Its sign does not mean sufficient, insufficient, reservable, unavailable, available, remaining, ATP, accepted, rejected or governing capacity.
writerBoundary: FOOD-007M performs no authoritative reservation write and does not prevent oversell or overbooking.
acceptanceBoundary: FOOD-007M does not create, validate as authoritative, infer or authenticate a reservation acceptance.
lifecycleBoundary: FOOD-007M does not decide whether previously recorded held commitments are currently active after any future release, expiration, cancellation, replacement, rescheduling or consumption lifecycle.
crossRevisionBoundary: FOOD-007M performs no cross-revision carry-forward or commitment accounting.
concurrencyBoundary: FOOD-007M performs no reads or writes and does not create a fixed simultaneous snapshot. It composes previously obtained artifacts only.
physicalInventoryBoundary: No physical quantity on hand, physical inventory truth or physical movement is established.
sideEffects: Pure synchronous composition. No database access, SQL, writes, reservation mutation, acceptance creation, routes, clocks, network access, environment access, randomness, migration execution or production mutation.
